review_procedure: Before merging a deferral, the release owner must approve its exact feature ID, rationale, and target release in a QQQ issue comment or PR review. Copy that direct permalink into owner_approval. The reviewer must open the link and confirm the author and matching details; URL format validation alone does not prove approval. Record accepted deferrals in release issue #790 before publishing, and remove each entry once verified.

accepted_next_release.rationale: Maintainer accepts the published NextRC1 browser/parity/visual limitations for coordinated RC1. Full successor certification remains pending; source and public compatibility checks remain required. This does not certify any missing or failed test.
accepted_next_release.target_release: Next 1.0 final; intermediate Next RCs pair with new QQQ4.1 RCs and explicit updated acceptance decisions.
